special_episode_count.reason: The special content consists of a single OAD episode titled '#23 MOMENTS' (or 'MOMENTS'), which is counted as the 23rd episode in the total count of 23 (22 TV + 1 OAD).

evidence.quote: 2015年5月15日に発売のコミックス最終11巻限定版に同梱!

special_release_date.reason: The OAD 'MOMENTS' was released as a bonus for the limited edition of the 11th manga volume on May 15, 2015. While it was later included in the 2020 BD-BOX, the initial release date of the special content is 2015-05-15.

answer.identity_notes: The target scope is the OAD special, not the 22-episode TV series. The OAD is titled '#23 MOMENTS' and was originally released with the 11th manga volume. It is a single episode.
